baseline.change_policy: Keep every V6 archived file unchanged.

required_before_execution: Implement and validate matched adapters and independent outcome fixtures.
Declare a whole-run disk and inode budget, shared dependency budget, and cleanup ownership manifest.
Set per-case time, memory, process, and connection limits.
Pre-register independent-unit counts, workload sizes, failure boundaries, and stopping rules.
Any real-model confirmation requires a separately defined budget; historical authorization text is not inherited.

reporting.rule: No product scores or architectural causal claims are generated from design completeness or CI success.

dimensions.name: Reliability and recoverability
dimensions.review_gap: V6 already tests restart and side effects. Its own evidence review leaves the complete intervention-time contract unresolved; fixed trigger points also need systematic coverage of persistence and acknowledgment boundaries.

after acknowledgment but before worker dispatch
